events.title: Node.js 12 released
events.summary: Node.js 12.0.0 shipped on April 23, 2019 with V8 7.4, improved startup performance, and stable [HTTP]/2.
events.about: Node 12 became LTS in October 2019 — powering serverless functions, Next.js apps, and npm's largest package era. Faster startup helped cold-start latency on AWS Lambda and Vercel; diagnostic reports improved production debugging.

narrative.whyChosen: Node 12 LTS was the default runtime for serverless and JAMstack deployments.
narrative.whyImportant: Startup speed and [HTTP]/2 maturity made Node competitive for edge and cloud functions.
narrative.problemSolved: Cold starts and slow [HTTP]/1.1 limited Node in serverless and high-throughput APIs.

events.title: South Korea launches commercial 5G NR
events.summary: South Korean carriers opened commercial 5G NR service nationwide on April 5, 2019 — the first large-scale rollout of fifth-generation cellular data.
events.about: 5G NR targets gigabit-class peak speeds, lower latency, and denser small-cell deployment — assumptions behind cloud gaming on phones, AR prototypes, and edge compute experiments. SK Telecom, KT, and LG Uplus beat rival launch clocks by days, but the lasting impact is a new radio generation developers benchmark against for real-time mobile apps.

narrative.whyChosen: South Korea's April 2019 launch was the first nationwide commercial 5G NR deployment.
narrative.whyImportant: It marked the cellular generation built for machine-to-machine and high-bandwidth mobile workloads.
narrative.problemSolved: LTE alone could not meet projected demand for ultra-low latency and multi-gigabit mobile traffic.
